prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Reset Warning Callout: Display a prominent warning hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users to log in with their original account to preserve existing pet profiles. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.)
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Controls Checklist Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into an interactive checklist layout that walks users through basic desktop pet controls like hiding, dragging, and tray settings. (why: Mean finish time is high (5815s) and multiple support emails cite confusion over pet controls and desktop feature navigation.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Live Pet Render Preview Flow: Introduce a live interactive preview component during photo upload and selection so users can see and adjust their custom pet visual rendering before confirming adoption. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failing or results looking wrong, and adoption has a drop-off rate of 30.4%.)
3: [home, hint] Desktop Display Diagnostic Check: Show a clear status diagnostic on the waiting screen confirming screen overlay permissions and hardware acceleration support before launching the desktop pet. (why: 3 support complaints reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open, while waiting time averages 2336s.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Split Layout Path Selection: Redesign choose_path into a side-by-side split layout comparing preset quick pets versus custom photo pets with immediate feature previews. (why: Choose path step has a very high mean time (514s vs median 8s), indicating user confusion or hesitation.)
5: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Quick Controls Summary: Update adoption certificate layout to a card format featuring clear desktop shortcut badges and key gesture controls for hiding and interacting with the pet. (why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls while making adoption feel official.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Interactive Story Mascot Guide: Add an animated mascot guide to the story screen explaining desktop pet abilities with engaging visual badges. (why: Story screen drop-off and high mean time (514s) indicate users need clearer early value demonstration.)
